description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission class in the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating permissions related to user roles and their CRUD capabilities within data groups.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Represents permissions for a user role related to data group operations, including read, create, update, delete, and self-permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroupPermission object with specified role and permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DataGroupPermission instance from an associative array specifying role and permissions.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the user role associated with this permission.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Indicates whether the role has read permission.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Indicates whether the role has create permission.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Indicates whether the role has update permission.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Indicates whether the role has delete permission.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Indicates whether the permission is self-related.
